finalText:
Found it: `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js` converted the subtotal to the target currency first, then subtracted the flat coupon as if it were already in that currency. But flat coupons are stored in USD, so the discount was landing at the wrong size for any non-USD checkout.

Fixed it to subtract flat coupons from the USD subtotal before converting, and convert only afterward. Percent coupons still apply after conversion since they're currency-agnostic.

All 5 tests pass, 70ms.
